meta.name: plan-interrogate
meta.description: Stress-test a plan by walking its decision tree one question at a time. Use when the user wants to pressure-test a design before implementation.

copy.tagline: 逐问推敲设计方案，提前发现潜在问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在实施前系统性地检验一个计划或设计。
copy.tagline_en: Stress-test your plan by walking its decision tree question by question.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to systematically challenge a plan or design before implementation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你审查一个计划，逐个解决每个未决决策，直到所有分支都确定下来。它每次只问一个问题，并给出推荐答案。
howto.when: 当你要求对某个设计方案进行压力测试，或在写代码前想先确认计划时触发。

say.text: 帮我审查这个新功能的实现计划。
say.note: Claude 会复述计划并开始逐项提问。

say.text: 压力测试一下我的数据库迁移方案。
say.note: Claude 会提取决策树并依次询问未决节点。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps you stress-test a plan by walking its decision tree one question at a time, resolving every open decision before any code is written. It asks one question per step with a recommended answer.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to pressure-test a design before implementation, or to confirm a plan before coding.

say_en.text: Review my implementation plan for this new feature.
say_en.note: Claude restates the plan and starts asking questions.
Claude extracts the decision tree and resolves open nodes.
